description: TEST FIXTURE for safe_expressions regex allowlists (R3). Exact lists EMPTY; only the *_regex keys are populated, proving regex-only operation.
_comment_safe_expressions: Exact lists intentionally EMPTY (absent) so every allow below can ONLY come from the regex keys. dotnet_static_method_allowlist defaults to empty (fail-closed); dotnet_method_allowlist would default to the built-in ~40-name list, so the instance positive case uses ToCharArray which is NOT in that default.

safe_expressions._comment_static_regex: One pattern covers BOTH the short alias (regex::IsMatch) and the reflected full name (system.text.regularexpressions.regex::Matches), per spec 5.6. Case-insensitive.
safe_expressions._comment_instance_regex: ToCharArray is deliberately NOT in the built-in default instance list, so an allow can only come from this regex (proves regex-only operation).
